why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: Open the Titan waitlist and connect a wallet. Titan says this is a signature only, with no transaction and no gas. You get a waitlist position and a referral link.
Open the Titan testnet and connect. It accepts Canton wallets, EVM wallets through WalletConnect, or a login by email, passkey or Google.

Click "Enable trading" and sign the message, then enter a referral code. The testnet is invite-only, but the screen offers "No code? Use Titan's" if you don't have one. You can't change your referrer later.
Claim testnet tokens. This is test USDC with no real value, and you can top it up for free once your balance drops under 2,000 USDC.
Place a first perpetuals order. The app walks you through it on the BTC market .
Check your points and rank on the Rewards page .
